heroHeadline: Romania's Cernavodă Restart Unlikely in October as Danube Flow Stays Below August Average
heroSubtitle: A government document seen by Montel on 1 October says the 1.35 GW Cernavodă plant, about 20% of Romania's generation, is unlikely to restart this month because Danube levels remain too low; its two units have been offline since 28 July and 13 August. EFFIS's last recorded EU-wide burned area on this tracker is 678,978 hectares as of 23 September. No new wildfire outbreaks, fatalities or evacuations were found in searches for 27 September to 5 October.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
